name: Boys
overview: Scripture reminds us that salvation and eternal life come through faith in Jesus Christ, who is the only way to the Father. Believers, including boys, are called to love God and trust that all things work together for their good according to His purpose. They are encouraged to focus their minds on what is true, honest, just, pure, and praiseworthy, living in a way that honors God. At the same time, the seriousness of willful sin after knowing the truth is underscored, highlighting the need for continual faithfulness and reliance on Christ's sacrifice.
